findings.problem: Top-level fractions use \tfrac here, in the Delta P display, and in Example 10. The rule is \dfrac at top level; \tfrac sets the half at script size, the small size the maths rule exists to avoid. The base wrote \frac12, which the renderer promotes, but \tfrac is explicit.
